title: Independent label normalization service
contamination_rule: This task is independently authored. It must not reference Tutor paths, source, tests, identifiers, STOP labels, completion packages, or behavior text.

requirements.statement: Expose GET /health that returns JSON declaring the service healthy.
Expose POST /v1/labels/normalize. Given a JSON object with a string field label, return its trimmed, lower-cased value with internal whitespace collapsed to one space.
Reject a missing, non-string, or blank label with a client-error JSON response; do not persist request data.
